rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the exactness or accuracy of a result.

example.english: The precision of this instrument’s measurements is very high.
example.traditional: 呢部儀器測量嘅準確度好高。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 ji4 hei3 cak1 loeng4 ge3 zeon2 kok3 dou6 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this in measurement contexts when repeated measurements give consistent results, regardless of their closeness to the true value.

example.english: We took the measurement several times, and the results had high precision.
example.traditional: 我哋重複量咗幾次，結果嘅精密度都好高。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cung4 fuk1 loeng4 zo2 gei2 ci3 git3 gwo2 ge3 zing1 mat6 dou6 dou1 hou2 gou1

rows.jyutping: jau5 haau6 sou3 zi6 wai2 sou3
rows.note: Use this when precision means how many significant digits a measured value reliably contains.

example.english: The precision of this reading is limited to three significant digits.
example.traditional: 呢個讀數只可以報到三個有效數字位數。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 duk6 sou3 zi2 ho2 ji5 bou3 dou3 saam1 go3 jau5 haau6 sou3 zi6 wai2 sou3
